notes: «عَنْ أَحْمَدَ» after «أحمد بن محمد» is read as the same man written again in succession (rule 7): one link, the fuller form.
«أو عمن ذكره عنه» is an alternative to the Imam at the same level: an unnamed transmitter, not a route beyond the Imam.
«حَدَّثَنِي» opens with the compiler's father by relation («أبي»).
